# Plyler's Tree Service

> Locally owned, licensed and insured tree service based in Arkadelphia, Arkansas, serving Clark, Hot Spring, Garland, Pike, and Montgomery counties within about a 40-mile radius. Owner-operated by Robbie Plyler since 2002 — tree removal, trimming and pruning, stump grinding, and 24/7 emergency storm response. 5.0★ on Google with 70+ reviews. Free written estimates. Call (870) 245-7944.

Key facts:

- Phone: (870) 245-7944
- Email: info@plylerstreeservice.com
- Regular hours: Mon–Fri 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Sat 7:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Emergency storm response is available 24/7 — that is the exception to the posted hours, not the everyday schedule.
- Base: Arkadelphia, AR 71923. Service Area Business — crews travel to the property. There is no public customer-facing storefront; the equipment yard on Country Club Drive is an operational site, not a place to send customers.
- Owner: Robbie Plyler. Family- and veteran-owned, in business since 2002, 24+ years of experience.
- Licensed and insured. Free written estimates on every job.
- Rating: 5.0★ on Google across 70+ reviews
- Coverage: Clark, Hot Spring, Garland, Pike, and Montgomery counties, Arkansas — roughly a 40-mile radius from Arkadelphia
- Practice note: trees are pruned with proper branch-collar cuts. Plyler's does not top trees.

## Core Services

- [Tree Removal](https://www.plylerstreeservice.com/tree-removal): Safe sectional removal of hazardous, dead, and storm-damaged trees across Clark County — Arkadelphia, Bismarck, Caddo Valley, Hot Springs, and Malvern. Locally owned since 2002.
- [Tree Trimming & Pruning](https://www.plylerstreeservice.com/tree-trimming): Trimming and pruning with proper branch-collar cuts and no topping, across Clark County and the surrounding area.
- [Stump Grinding](https://www.plylerstreeservice.com/stump-grinding): Stumps ground 6–8 inches below grade so the spot can be reseeded, landscaped, or mowed — across Clark County and into Hot Springs and Malvern.
- [Emergency Storm Damage](https://www.plylerstreeservice.com/emergency-storm-damage): 24/7 emergency tree response across Clark County — trees on houses, blocked roads, and downed limbs in Arkadelphia, Bismarck, and Caddo Valley.
